description: This file defines a Dart service class 'OpenAIChatService' that communicates with the OpenAI API for chat-based interactions. It includes error handling, request creation, response parsing, and contains enums and classes for error management and exception handling related to OpenAI API communication.

classes.name: ChatGPTError
classes.description: Enumeration representing various error types from the OpenAI API.

classes.name: ChatGPTException
classes.description: Exception wrapper class that encapsulates a ChatGPTError and additional details.

classes.name: OpenAIChatService
classes.description: Service class implementing chat communication with OpenAI's API using HTTP requests.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Main method to send a list of chat messages to OpenAI and receive assistant content as a string.

methods.name: _extractOpenAIErrorDetail
methods.description: Extracts error message details from an HTTP response from OpenAI.

methods.name: _extractBodySnippet
methods.description: Returns a truncated snippet of the response body for display or logging.

methods.name: _describeNetworkFailure
methods.description: Creates a human-readable description of network or connection errors.

methods.name: _extractTextFromResponsesOutput
methods.description: Parses the 'output' field from a Responses API JSON payload.

methods.name: _extractTextFromChatCompletions
methods.description: Extracts assistant text content from Chat Completions-like JSON response.
